items.name: Neem tree
items.visual_cues: Dense rounded dark-green crown; long pinnate leaves with curved sickle-shaped serrated leaflets; dark grey furrowed bark; clusters of tiny white star flowers; olive-shaped green-to-yellow fruits

items.name: Bakain (Persian lilac)
items.visual_cues: Feathery bipinnate leaves with toothed leaflets; lilac-purple fragrant flower clusters in spring; hanging bunches of round yellow bead-like berries on bare winter branches

items.name: Peepal tree
items.visual_cues: Large spreading tree; heart-shaped glossy leaves ending in a long drawn-out tail tip, fluttering in wind; smooth grey bark; often with threads, lamps or a small shrine at the base

items.name: Banyan tree
items.visual_cues: Massive wide canopy; many thick aerial roots hanging down and forming pillar-like extra trunks; large oval leathery leaves with pale veins; small round red figs

items.name: Gulmohar (Flame tree)
items.visual_cues: Umbrella-shaped wide flat crown; fine fern-like feathery bipinnate leaves; blazing red-orange flowers covering the crown in summer; long flat dark-brown sword-like pods hanging

items.name: Date palm
items.visual_cues: Single tall rough trunk covered in diamond-patterned old leaf bases; crown of stiff grey-green feather fronds with spiny bases; hanging orange, yellow or brown date bunches

items.name: Coconut palm
items.visual_cues: Tall slender often leaning grey trunk with faint rings; crown of long drooping bright-green feather fronds; clusters of large green or brown coconuts just under the crown

items.name: Royal palm
items.visual_cues: Very straight smooth pale-grey concrete-like trunk, slightly swollen; glossy green crownshaft below the fronds; arching feather fronds; planted in formal rows

items.name: Fan palm (Washingtonia)
items.visual_cues: Tall thin trunk; crown of round fan-shaped palmate leaves; skirt of dead brown fronds hanging under the crown

items.name: Areca palm (Golden cane)
items.visual_cues: Clump of many thin yellowish bamboo-like ringed stems; arching feathery yellow-green fronds; often in pots or as a screen

items.name: Moringa (Drumstick tree)
items.visual_cues: Small slender tree with sparse drooping branches; lacy airy leaves of tiny round leaflets; creamy white flowers; long thin green ribbed drumstick pods hanging down

items.name: Mango tree
items.visual_cues: Large dense dome-shaped evergreen crown; long narrow lance-shaped dark-green leathery leaves, new leaves copper-red; pyramid-shaped flower sprays; green-yellow mangoes hanging on long stalks

items.name: Tamarind tree
items.visual_cues: Large tree with feathery pinnate leaves of tiny oblong leaflets; dark rough bark; curved brown velvety bean-like pods hanging

items.name: Jamun tree
items.visual_cues: Tall evergreen tree; glossy opposite oval leaves with pointed tips; flaking grey bark; clusters of small oval deep-purple almost black fruits; purple stains on the ground below

items.name: Guava tree
items.visual_cues: Small tree with smooth mottled peeling copper-brown bark; oval leaves with deep parallel veins; white fluffy flowers; round green guavas

items.name: Sheesham (Indian rosewood)
items.visual_cues: Tall tree with zigzag twigs; leaves of 3-5 rounded pointed alternate leaflets that flutter; thin flat papery pale-brown pods; rough grey-brown bark

items.name: Kikar (Babool)
items.visual_cues: Thorny tree with paired long white thorns; feathery fine bipinnate leaves; bright yellow fluffy ball flowers; necklace-like beaded grey pods; dark cracked bark

items.name: Mesquite (Vilayati babool)
items.visual_cues: Scrubby sprawling thorny shrub-tree with arching branches; feathery bipinnate leaves; yellow-green catkin-like flower spikes; long curved yellow pods; takes over empty plots

items.name: Farash (Athel tamarisk)
items.visual_cues: Tree with drooping jointed grey-green needle-like twigs that look like pine but have no flat leaves; rough dark bark; often in rows as windbreaks

items.name: Conocarpus
items.visual_cues: Dense upright tree or clipped hedge of small shiny lance-shaped leaves (green or silvery); tiny brown button-like cone fruits; planted in long rows on road medians

items.name: Eucalyptus
items.visual_cues: Tall tree with smooth patchy white, grey and tan peeling bark; long narrow hanging sickle-shaped grey-green leaves; strips of shed bark on ground

items.name: Ashoka (Mast tree)
items.visual_cues: Tall narrow conical tree like a green pillar; long drooping glossy wavy-edged leaves hanging down along the trunk; planted in rows

items.name: Amaltas (Golden shower)
items.visual_cues: Medium tree covered in long hanging chandelier clusters of bright yellow flowers in summer; long cylindrical dark-brown stick pods; pinnate leaves with large oval leaflets

items.name: Copper pod (Peltophorum)
items.visual_cues: Spreading tree with fine fern-like leaves; upright clusters of golden-yellow crinkled flowers on top of the crown; flat copper-red winged pods

items.name: Jacaranda
items.visual_cues: Fern-like delicate bipinnate leaves; masses of lavender-blue trumpet flowers covering the crown; round flat woody seed pods

items.name: Semal (Red silk cotton)
items.visual_cues: Tall straight trunk with conical thorns and buttress base; horizontal tiered branches; big cup-shaped red waxy flowers on bare branches in spring; pods bursting with white cotton

items.name: Rubber fig
items.visual_cues: Large thick glossy dark-green or burgundy oval leathery leaves; red pointed sheath at the growing tip; aerial roots

items.name: Weeping fig (Ficus hedge)
items.visual_cues: Small glossy pointed oval leaves on drooping twigs; often clipped into dense hedges, balls or topiary shapes; smooth grey bark; tiny round figs

items.name: Indian almond (Badam tree)
items.visual_cues: Pagoda-shaped tree with flat horizontal tiers of branches; huge paddle-shaped glossy leaves clustered at branch tips, turning red before falling; green almond-shaped fruits

items.name: Siris
items.visual_cues: Spreading tree with bipinnate leaves of oblong leaflets; fluffy greenish-white powder-puff fragrant flowers; many flat straw-coloured papery pods that rattle in wind

items.name: Sukhchain (Pongamia)
items.visual_cues: Dense shade tree with glossy bright-green pinnate leaves of 5-7 oval leaflets; pale lilac-white pea flowers; flat thick woody bean pods with one seed

items.name: Kachnar (Orchid tree)
items.visual_cues: Small tree with distinctive two-lobed camel-hoof or butterfly-shaped leaves; orchid-like pink, purple or white five-petal flowers; long flat pods

items.name: Ber (Indian jujube)
items.visual_cues: Thorny scrubby tree with zigzag branches; small oval leaves dark-green above and whitish-fuzzy below with three veins; small round green-to-reddish-brown fruits

items.name: Pilu (Miswak tree)
items.visual_cues: Drooping bushy evergreen tree with pale thick fleshy oval leaves; tangled weeping branches; clusters of tiny red-pink translucent berries

items.name: Papaya tree
items.visual_cues: Single unbranched soft green-grey trunk with leaf scars; umbrella of huge deeply lobed hand-shaped leaves on long hollow stalks; cluster of green or yellow papayas hugging the trunk

items.name: Banana plant
items.visual_cues: Large herb with fleshy stem; huge long paddle-shaped bright-green leaves often torn into strips; hanging purple teardrop flower bud above a bunch of green bananas

items.name: Chir pine
items.visual_cues: Conical evergreen with long needles in bundles; reddish deeply plated bark; woody cones; found in northern hills such as Murree

items.name: Deodar cedar
items.visual_cues: Large conical tree with horizontal tiered drooping branches; short blue-green needles in rosettes; barrel-shaped upright cones

items.name: Chinar (Oriental plane)
items.visual_cues: Huge spreading tree; large maple-like 5-lobed leaves turning red-orange in autumn; camouflage patchwork peeling bark; spiky hanging seed balls

items.name: Poplar
items.visual_cues: Tall narrow tree with straight whitish-grey trunk; triangular heart-shaped leaves that shimmer in wind; planted in rows along fields and canals

items.name: Weeping willow
items.visual_cues: Tree with a long cascading curtain of thin drooping branches reaching the ground; narrow lance leaves; usually beside water

items.name: Oak tree
items.visual_cues: Broad sturdy tree with deeply furrowed bark; lobed wavy-edged leaves; acorns sitting in little scaly cups

items.name: Maple tree
items.visual_cues: Pointed 3-5 lobed hand-shaped leaves turning brilliant red or orange in autumn; paired winged helicopter seeds

items.name: Italian cypress
items.visual_cues: Very narrow dark-green pencil or flame-shaped column conifer; dense scale-like foliage; small round cones

items.name: Norfolk Island pine
items.visual_cues: Symmetrical Christmas-tree shape with perfectly horizontal tiers of branches radiating from a straight trunk; soft bright-green needle-like foliage

items.name: Casuarina (Jhau)
items.visual_cues: Tall feathery pine-looking tree with drooping thin green jointed needle-like twigs; small spiky cone-like fruits; often near beaches

items.name: Grey mangrove (Timar)
items.visual_cues: Low grey-green bushy trees growing in tidal mud and water; thick oval leaves silvery underneath; many pencil-like breathing roots poking up out of the mud

items.name: Bottlebrush
items.visual_cues: Weeping shrub-tree with narrow leaves; bright red cylindrical bottle-brush flower spikes made of bristly stamens; woody seed capsules along the stems

items.name: Lemon tree
items.visual_cues: Small dense thorny tree with glossy oval leaves; white star flowers; round or oval green or yellow lemons hanging

items.name: Bougainvillea
items.visual_cues: Thorny climbing shrub draping over walls and gates; masses of papery vivid magenta, pink, orange, white or red bracts around tiny white tube flowers

items.name: Hibiscus (Gurhal)
items.visual_cues: Large funnel-shaped flower with five broad petals, usually red, orange or pink, with a long stamen column sticking out of the centre; glossy toothed leaves

items.name: Rose
items.visual_cues: Layered spiral of velvety petals forming a cup; red, pink, white or yellow; thorny stems; serrated compound leaves

items.name: Marigold (Genda)
items.visual_cues: Dense round pom-pom flowers of ruffled orange or yellow petals; feathery finely divided dark-green leaves; often in rows or strung into garlands

items.name: Jasmine (Motia)
items.visual_cues: Bushy shrub with glossy oval leaves; small waxy pure-white fragrant flowers, single or doubled like tiny roses

items.name: Raat ki Rani (Night jasmine)
items.visual_cues: Lanky shrub with clusters of thin greenish-white tubular flowers that open at night; glossy lance leaves; white berries

items.name: Oleander (Kaner)
items.visual_cues: Dense shrub with long narrow leathery dark leaves in whorls; clusters of pink, white or red five-petal pinwheel flowers; common on road medians; poisonous if eaten

items.name: Yellow oleander (Pila kaner)
items.visual_cues: Shrub-tree with glossy narrow linear leaves; yellow or peach funnel-shaped twisted flowers; green angular triangular fruits; all parts toxic

items.name: Frangipani (Champa)
items.visual_cues: Stubby thick candelabra branches with large paddle leaves at the tips; fragrant waxy five-petal pinwheel flowers, white with yellow centre or pink/red

items.name: Periwinkle (Sadabahar)
items.visual_cues: Low bushy plant with glossy oval leaves; flat five-petal pink, magenta or white flowers with a darker eye in the centre

items.name: Ixora
items.visual_cues: Dense shrub with stiff glossy leaves; rounded ball clusters of many small red, orange or pink four-petal tube flowers

items.name: Lantana
items.visual_cues: Scrubby shrub with rough toothed leaves; small dome clusters of tiny flowers in mixed yellow, orange, pink and red within one head; shiny black berries (toxic)

items.name: Yellow bells (Tecoma)
items.visual_cues: Shrub with toothed pinnate leaves; clusters of bright yellow trumpet or bell flowers; long thin bean pods

items.name: Allamanda
items.visual_cues: Vining shrub with glossy whorled leaves; large golden-yellow trumpet flowers with five rounded overlapping petals

items.name: Morning glory
items.visual_cues: Twining vine with heart-shaped leaves; funnel-shaped trumpet flowers in purple, blue, pink or white that open in the morning; climbs fences

items.name: Sunflower
items.visual_cues: Very large flower head with bright yellow petals around a big brown seed disc; tall thick hairy stem; large rough heart-shaped leaves

items.name: Zinnia
items.visual_cues: Single upright flower with neat layered stiff petals in hot pink, red, orange or yellow; small raised centre

items.name: Cosmos
items.visual_cues: Airy daisy-like flowers with 8 broad notched petals in pink, magenta, white or orange; thin threadlike feathery leaves

items.name: Petunia
items.visual_cues: Low spreading potted plant with soft sticky leaves; open trumpet flowers purple, pink or white, often veined or striped

items.name: Chrysanthemum (Gul-e-daudi)
items.visual_cues: Dense rounded heads of many incurved or spoon-shaped petals in white, yellow, bronze or purple; lobed aromatic leaves; winter flower shows

items.name: Lotus
items.visual_cues: Big pink or white many-petalled flower held high above water; huge round waxy umbrella leaves raised above the surface; shower-head seed pod

items.name: Water lily
items.visual_cues: Star-shaped flower floating on water with pointed petals in white, pink, blue or purple; flat round leaves with a slit floating on the surface

items.name: Crown of thorns
items.visual_cues: Spiny grey woody stems with long thorns; few small leaves at the tips; pairs of small red, pink or yellow rounded bracts; milky toxic sap

items.name: Aak (Calotropis)
items.visual_cues: Grey-green shrub with big thick waxy oval leaves; clusters of crown-shaped white-and-purple waxy flowers; inflated green balloon pods releasing silky seeds; toxic milky sap

items.name: Datura
items.visual_cues: Bushy weed with large white or purple upright trumpet flowers; big toothed leaves; round spiky green seed capsule; highly poisonous

items.name: Bird of paradise
items.visual_cues: Flower shaped like a bird's head: orange crest petals and a blue tongue rising from a beak-like green-purple bract; large paddle leaves

items.name: Canna lily
items.visual_cues: Tall plant with big broad banana-like green or bronze leaves; clusters of bright red, orange or yellow irregular flowers on top

items.name: Rain lily
items.visual_cues: Small crocus-like pink or white six-petal star flowers on single stems popping up from grass after rain; thin grassy leaves

items.name: Plumbago
items.visual_cues: Mounded shrub with clusters of pale sky-blue five-petal flowers on long thin tubes

items.name: Duranta (Golden dewdrop)
items.visual_cues: Hedge shrub, often the lime-green-leaved variety; drooping sprays of small violet-blue flowers with white edges; hanging clusters of golden-orange berries

items.name: Coral vine
items.visual_cues: Climbing vine with heart-shaped wavy leaves and tendrils; long sprays of small pink heart-shaped flowers draping fences

items.name: Poinsettia
items.visual_cues: Shrub with large bright red (or white) leaf-like bracts arranged in a star around tiny yellow centres

items.name: Moss rose (Portulaca)
items.visual_cues: Low mat of fleshy needle-like succulent leaves; small satiny cup flowers in vivid pink, orange, yellow or red, often in pots

items.name: Gazania
items.visual_cues: Low rosette plant; daisy-like flowers in orange or yellow with dark rings or stripes near the centre; leaves silvery underneath

items.name: Cockscomb (Celosia)
items.visual_cues: Flowers like velvety crinkled rooster combs or feathery flame plumes in red, magenta or yellow

items.name: Dandelion
items.visual_cues: Bright yellow shaggy flower head on a hollow stem; toothed rosette leaves; white fluffy round seed clock

items.name: Tulip
items.visual_cues: Smooth cup-shaped upright flower with six petals in solid red, yellow or pink; broad grey-green strap leaves

items.name: Cherry blossom
items.visual_cues: Trees covered in clouds of pale pink or white five-petal blossoms on dark bare branches; notched petals

items.name: Prickly pear cactus
items.visual_cues: Cactus of flat oval paddle-shaped pads joined in chains; clusters of tiny spines on dots; yellow flowers and red-purple pear-shaped fruits on the pad edges

items.name: Thohar (Candelabra spurge)
items.visual_cues: Leafless cylindrical green succulent stems branching like a candelabra; small paired spines along ridges; used as village hedges; toxic white latex

items.name: Column cactus
items.visual_cues: Tall upright ribbed blue-green columns with spines along the ribs; sometimes branching; large white night flowers

items.name: Barrel cactus
items.visual_cues: Globe or barrel-shaped ribbed cactus covered in stout golden spines; ring of flowers on top

items.name: Aloe vera
items.visual_cues: Rosette of thick fleshy grey-green lance leaves with soft toothed edges and white speckles; tall spike of tubular yellow-orange flowers

items.name: Agave (Century plant)
items.visual_cues: Huge rosette of stiff thick blue-grey sword leaves with sharp tip spines and hooked edge teeth

items.name: Snake plant
items.visual_cues: Upright stiff sword-shaped leaves with dark-green wavy bands, often yellow edges; in pots at doorways

items.name: Jade plant
items.visual_cues: Mini tree-like succulent with thick woody stems and plump glossy oval coin-shaped leaves, sometimes red-edged

items.name: Money plant (Pothos)
items.visual_cues: Trailing vine with heart-shaped glossy leaves splashed yellow and green; climbing walls and tree trunks

items.name: Croton
items.visual_cues: Shrub with thick leathery leaves splashed with yellow, orange, red and green veins and spots; leaves oval, twisted or narrow

items.name: Tulsi (Holy basil)
items.visual_cues: Small bushy herb with aromatic oval toothed green or purplish leaves; thin purple flower spikes; often in a pot

items.name: Mehndi (Henna) hedge
items.visual_cues: Clipped dense hedge of small opposite elliptical leaves; clusters of tiny fragrant cream flowers; small round seed capsules

items.name: Lawn grass (Doob)
items.visual_cues: Low carpet of fine creeping grass with finger-like seed spikes radiating from stem tops

items.name: Sarkanda (Munj grass)
items.visual_cues: Huge clumps of tall stiff grass with long arching leaves and silvery-pinkish feathery plumes on tall stems

items.name: Kans grass
items.visual_cues: Tall grass with fluffy pure-white silky plumes waving in masses along canals and empty land after the monsoon

items.name: Bamboo
items.visual_cues: Tall clumps of hollow jointed green or yellow canes with ring nodes; narrow lance leaves in feathery sprays

items.name: Sugarcane field
items.visual_cues: Dense rows of tall thick jointed purple-green canes with long arching leaves; feathery plumes when flowering

items.name: Wheat field
items.visual_cues: Field of grass with dense bristled ears; green in winter turning golden yellow before harvest; stacked sheaves

items.name: Rice paddy
items.visual_cues: Flooded flat field with rows of bright-green grass tufts; drooping golden grain heads near harvest

items.name: Cotton plant
items.visual_cues: Shrubby plant with maple-like lobed leaves; cream or pink hibiscus-like flowers; bolls bursting into fluffy white cotton balls

items.name: Mustard field (Sarson)
items.visual_cues: Sea of bright yellow small four-petal flowers on tall slender plants

items.name: Cattail (Kundar)
items.visual_cues: Tall flat sword-like leaves along water; brown velvety sausage-shaped seed heads on stiff stalks

items.name: Water hyacinth
items.visual_cues: Floating mats of glossy round leaves with swollen spongy stalks; lilac-blue flower spikes with a yellow eye patch

items.name: Papyrus
items.visual_cues: Tall smooth triangular green stems topped with large mop-heads of thin thread-like rays like fireworks

items.name: Fern
items.visual_cues: Feathery fronds divided into many small leaflets, uncurling as fiddleheads; brown spore dots under the fronds

items.name: Castor plant
items.visual_cues: Large shrub with huge star-shaped hand-like leaves, often reddish; clusters of spiky red or green seed capsules; seeds highly poisonous

items.name: Parthenium weed (Congress grass)
items.visual_cues: Bushy weed with deeply divided pale-green leaves; many tiny white button flowers in branched sprays; causes skin allergies

items.name: Dodder (Amar bel)
items.visual_cues: Leafless tangled mass of thin yellow-orange spaghetti-like threads draped over shrubs and trees

items.name: Ivy gourd vine (Kundru)
items.visual_cues: Climbing vine with ivy-shaped five-lobed leaves and coiled tendrils; white bell flowers; small green striped cucumber-like fruits turning red

items.name: Peepal sapling on a wall
items.visual_cues: Small shrub with heart-shaped pointed leaves growing out of cracks in old walls, roofs and drainpipes, roots gripping bricks

items.name: House crow
items.visual_cues: Black crow with a smoky-grey neck, nape and breast collar; black face and bill; noisy groups on wires and rooftops

items.name: Large-billed crow (Jungle crow)
items.visual_cues: Entirely glossy black crow, bigger than the house crow, with a heavy thick arched bill and domed forehead; no grey collar

items.name: Common myna
items.visual_cues: Chocolate-brown bird with glossy black head; bright yellow bill, legs and bare skin patch around the eye; white wing patches in flight; walks on lawns

items.name: Bank myna
items.visual_cues: Bluish-grey myna with black cap; brick-red or orange bare skin behind the eye; yellow bill

items.name: Black kite (Cheel)
items.visual_cues: Large dark-brown raptor; long forked tail visible when soaring; circles in groups over the city; perches on poles and towers

items.name: Rock pigeon (Kabootar)
items.visual_cues: Blue-grey pigeon with iridescent green-purple neck, two black wing bars and red eyes; flocks in squares and on ledges

items.name: House sparrow (Chirya)
items.visual_cues: Small plump brown bird; male with grey crown, black bib and chestnut nape; female plain buff-brown; streaked back; stubby cone-shaped bill

items.name: Rose-ringed parakeet (Tota)
items.visual_cues: Bright green parrot with long pointed tail and red hooked bill; male has a thin black-and-pink neck ring; noisy flocks

items.name: Red-vented bulbul
items.visual_cues: Smoky-brown bird with black crested head, scaly pattern on breast, bright red patch under the tail and white rump

items.name: White-eared bulbul
items.visual_cues: Grey-brown bird with black head and throat, large white cheek patch and yellow-orange patch under the tail; no crest

items.name: Purple sunbird
items.visual_cues: Tiny bird with a long down-curved needle bill; breeding male glossy metallic purple-black; female olive above and yellow below; hovers at flowers

items.name: Indian robin
items.visual_cues: Small bird with tail cocked upright; male black with a white shoulder patch and chestnut under the tail; female brown

items.name: Oriental magpie-robin
items.visual_cues: Black-and-white bird: glossy black head, back and breast, white belly and white wing stripe; long tail often cocked

items.name: Black drongo
items.visual_cues: Slim glossy all-black bird with a long deeply forked fish-tail; perches upright on wires

items.name: Laughing dove
items.visual_cues: Small slim pinkish-brown dove with blue-grey wings and a speckled black-and-copper necklace on the breast

items.name: Eurasian collared dove
items.visual_cues: Pale sandy-grey dove with a thin black half-collar on the back of the neck; long tail with white tips

items.name: Asian koel
items.visual_cues: Long-tailed cuckoo; male glossy blue-black with pale green bill and red eyes; female brown spotted and barred with white

items.name: Greater coucal (Crow pheasant)
items.visual_cues: Large crow-like bird with black body, bright chestnut wings, long broad tail and red eyes; skulks low in bushes

items.name: White-throated kingfisher
items.visual_cues: Electric turquoise-blue back and wings, chocolate-brown head and belly, white throat and bib, massive red dagger bill

items.name: Pied kingfisher
items.visual_cues: Black-and-white speckled kingfisher with shaggy crest and long black bill; hovers over water before diving

items.name: Little egret
items.visual_cues: Slender all-white heron with black dagger bill, black legs and yellow feet

items.name: Cattle egret
items.visual_cues: Stocky white heron with short yellow-orange bill and thick neck; follows cows and goats; buff-orange head when breeding

items.name: Indian pond heron
items.visual_cues: Hunched streaky brown heron at rest that bursts into bright white wings in flight; yellow-green legs

items.name: Grey heron
items.visual_cues: Tall grey heron with long S-shaped neck, white head with black eye stripe and plume, yellow dagger bill

items.name: Barn swallow
items.visual_cues: Slim glossy blue-black bird with rusty-red throat, white underparts and long forked tail streamers; lines up on wires

items.name: Eurasian hoopoe
items.visual_cues: Cinnamon-pink bird with zebra black-and-white barred wings, fan-shaped black-tipped crest and long curved bill; probes lawns

items.name: Indian peafowl (Peacock)
items.visual_cues: Large bird; male with iridescent blue neck, fan crest and a huge train of eye-spotted green tail feathers; female brown with green neck

items.name: Gull (Brown-headed / Black-headed)
items.visual_cues: White seabird with grey back, black wing tips, red or dark bill and legs; dark head when breeding; winter flocks over Karachi harbour and beach

items.name: Greater flamingo
items.visual_cues: Tall pale-pink wading bird with very long neck and legs and a bent pink-and-black bill; flocks in shallow lagoons

items.name: Little cormorant
items.visual_cues: Small all-black water bird with hooked bill; swims low and perches with wings spread out to dry

items.name: Red-wattled lapwing
items.visual_cues: Wader with black cap and breast, white cheek stripe, brown back, red bill and fleshy red wattle in front of the eye, long yellow legs

items.name: Black-winged stilt
items.visual_cues: Black-and-white wader with extraordinarily long thin pink-red legs and a needle-straight black bill

items.name: Grey francolin (Teetar)
items.visual_cues: Plump partridge-like ground bird finely barred grey-brown with rufous face and tail; runs rather than flies

items.name: Jungle babbler (Seven sisters)
items.visual_cues: Dull grey-brown bird with pale yellow eye and bill; untidy noisy groups hopping on the ground

items.name: Shikra
items.visual_cues: Small hawk with pale grey back, white underparts finely barred rufous, yellow eyes and legs; perches inside trees

items.name: Egyptian vulture
items.visual_cues: Medium vulture with dirty-white plumage, black flight feathers, bare yellow face, thin bill and shaggy neck; wedge-shaped tail

items.name: Indian roller (Neelkanth)
items.visual_cues: Stocky bird with pinkish-brown breast; brilliant electric-blue and turquoise bands flash on the wings in flight; perches on wires

items.name: Purple swamphen
items.visual_cues: Chicken-sized purple-blue water bird with a huge red bill and forehead shield, red legs and white under the tail

items.name: Spotted owlet
items.visual_cues: Small round owl, grey-brown spotted with white, with staring yellow eyes and white eyebrows; in tree holes and old buildings at dusk

items.name: Green bee-eater
items.visual_cues: Slim bright-green bird with copper-gold head, black eye stripe, curved bill and long needle tail streamers; on wires

items.name: Baya weaver
items.visual_cues: Sparrow-like bird; breeding male has a bright yellow crown and black face mask; builds hanging woven grass nests

items.name: Mallard duck
items.visual_cues: Duck; male with glossy green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast and grey body; female mottled brown; blue wing patch

items.name: Honey bee
items.visual_cues: Small fuzzy golden-brown bee with dark bands on the abdomen, see-through wings and pollen lumps on its legs; on flowers

items.name: Rock bee hive
items.visual_cues: Huge single half-moon honeycomb hanging from high branches, ledges or water tanks, covered in a shimmering curtain of bees; attacks in swarms

items.name: Paper wasp
items.visual_cues: Slim reddish-brown or yellow-and-black wasp with a narrow waist and dangling legs in flight

items.name: Wasp nest
items.visual_cues: Grey papery umbrella-shaped open comb of hexagonal cells hanging from a stalk under ledges

items.name: Oriental hornet
items.visual_cues: Large reddish-brown wasp with a yellow band on the abdomen and a yellow face; hovers at fruit and garbage

items.name: Dragonfly (Globe skimmer)
items.visual_cues: Long thin golden-orange abdomen, four clear wings held flat out sideways, huge eyes; swarms after rain

items.name: Crimson marsh glider
items.visual_cues: Dragonfly with a bright magenta-pink body and pink-veined wings perched on a twig over water

items.name: Damselfly
items.visual_cues: Very thin needle-like bright blue or green body; wings folded together over the back at rest; widely separated eyes

items.name: Plain tiger butterfly
items.visual_cues: Tawny orange butterfly with black-and-white spotted wing tips and a black body spotted white; slow gliding flight; often on aak plants

items.name: Lime butterfly
items.visual_cues: Large tailless swallowtail with black wings densely checkered with pale yellow spots and a red-and-blue eyespot near the rear

items.name: Common mormon
items.visual_cues: Large black swallowtail with a row of white spots across the hind wing, often with tails; females may show red spots

items.name: Blue pansy
items.visual_cues: Small butterfly with brilliant blue hind wings and black forewings with white bands and orange eyespots; basks on the ground

items.name: Painted lady
items.visual_cues: Orange-pink butterfly with black-tipped forewings bearing white spots; mottled grey-brown underside with eyespots

items.name: Pioneer white (Caper white)
items.visual_cues: White butterfly with bold black zigzag veins and black wing borders; often in migrating swarms

items.name: Monarch butterfly
items.visual_cues: Large orange butterfly with thick black veins and black borders dotted with white

items.name: Caterpillar
items.visual_cues: Soft segmented worm-like larva with many stubby legs, often green or striped, sometimes hairy, chewing leaves; hairy ones can irritate skin

items.name: Ladybird beetle
items.visual_cues: Tiny glossy dome-shaped beetle, red or orange with black spots

items.name: Praying mantis
items.visual_cues: Green or brown long-bodied insect with a triangular head, big eyes and spiny front legs folded up as if praying

items.name: Grasshopper
items.visual_cues: Green or brown insect with long folded wings, short antennae and big powerful hind jumping legs

items.name: Desert locust
items.visual_cues: Large grasshopper; mature adults yellow, young adults pinkish; may come in vast swarms darkening the sky and covering crops

items.name: Ant trail
items.visual_cues: Line of small black or reddish ants marching along walls, tree trunks or the ground; segmented bodies with bent antennae

items.name: Spider web
items.visual_cues: Circular wheel-shaped web of radiating spokes and spiral silk strung between branches, often glistening with dew

items.name: Signature spider
items.visual_cues: Large spider with a yellow, silver and black banded abdomen sitting head-down in the web centre beside a white zigzag X-shaped silk decoration

items.name: American cockroach
items.visual_cues: Large glossy reddish-brown flat oval insect with long antennae, near drains and garbage at night

items.name: Snail
items.visual_cues: Slow soft grey-brown slimy body with eye stalks carrying a coiled spiral shell; leaves a shiny slime trail; out after rain

items.name: Earthworm
items.visual_cues: Long pinkish-brown segmented smooth tube-like worm, appears on wet soil after rain

items.name: Centipede
items.visual_cues: Long flat segmented reddish or brown body with one pair of legs per segment and venomous pincers; hides under stones

items.name: Millipede
items.visual_cues: Cylindrical dark segmented body with many tiny legs; curls into a spiral when disturbed

items.name: Scorpion
items.visual_cues: Arachnid with two large pincers and a segmented tail curled over its back ending in a stinger; under rocks

items.name: House gecko (Chhipkali)
items.visual_cues: Small see-through pale pinkish-grey lizard with big eyes and sticky toe pads, clinging to outside walls near lights at night

items.name: Garden lizard (Girgit)
items.visual_cues: Brown-olive lizard with a spiky crest along its back and a long tail; male's head and throat turn bright red-orange

items.name: Bengal monitor lizard
items.visual_cues: Large grey-brown lizard up to 1.5 m long with a long neck, forked tongue, strong claws and a long flattened tail

items.name: Indian cobra
items.visual_cues: Dark brown to black snake that raises its front body and spreads a wide hood; highly venomous, photograph only from far away

items.name: Asian common toad
items.visual_cues: Warty brown-yellow squat toad with black-tipped bumps and bony ridges on the head; appears after monsoon rain

items.name: Indian bullfrog
items.visual_cues: Large frog, olive-green or bright yellow in breeding males with blue vocal sacs; smooth skin with a pale stripe down the back

items.name: Ghost crab
items.visual_cues: Pale sand-coloured crab with a square body and tall stalked eyes, darting into burrows on the beach

items.name: Fiddler crab
items.visual_cues: Small crab with one giant oversized claw, often orange or white, waving on muddy mangrove flats

items.name: Hermit crab
items.visual_cues: Small crab living in a borrowed snail shell with legs and claws poking out

items.name: Jellyfish
items.visual_cues: Transparent jelly dome-shaped blob washed up on sand or drifting, with trailing tentacles; can sting even when stranded

items.name: Green sea turtle
items.visual_cues: Large sea turtle with a smooth olive-brown heart-shaped shell and flippers; nests on Hawksbay and Sandspit beaches at night

items.name: Street dog
items.visual_cues: Medium-sized short-haired dog, usually tan, brown, black or white, lean with a curled tail; lying in shade or roaming in packs

items.name: Cat
items.visual_cues: Small furry cat with pointed ears and whiskers; tabby, orange, black, white or calico; sitting on walls, cars and rooftops

items.name: Indian palm squirrel (Gilheri)
items.visual_cues: Small grey-brown squirrel with five pale stripes along its back and a bushy tail; scurries up trees and walls

items.name: Goat
items.visual_cues: Medium animal with short upturned tail, beard, upright or long floppy ears, often horns; black, brown, white or spotted coat

items.name: Sheep
items.visual_cues: Woolly animal with thick curly fleece and short legs; many local breeds have fat tails or long drooping ears

items.name: Cow (Zebu)
items.visual_cues: Large cattle with a prominent shoulder hump, loose dewlap and long face; white, grey, brown or black; often decorated before Eid

items.name: Water buffalo (Bhains)
items.visual_cues: Massive dark-grey to black nearly hairless animal with backward-curving crescent horns; wallows in canals and ponds

items.name: Donkey
items.visual_cues: Small grey or brown animal with long upright ears, pale muzzle and short mane; often pulling a cart

items.name: Horse
items.visual_cues: Large animal with long mane and tail and short ears; beach horses wear colourful saddles

items.name: Camel
items.visual_cues: Tall sandy-brown animal with a single hump, long curved neck and padded feet; decorated saddles for beach rides at Clifton

items.name: Chicken (Hen / Rooster)
items.visual_cues: Domestic fowl; rooster with red comb and wattles and glossy arching tail; hen smaller, brown or white; scratching the ground

items.name: Domestic duck
items.visual_cues: White or mottled duck with a flat orange bill, waddling or swimming in ponds

items.name: Indian grey mongoose
items.visual_cues: Slim long-bodied grizzled grey animal with pointed snout, short legs and long bushy tail; dashes across paths

items.name: Rat
items.visual_cues: Brown-grey rodent with a long scaly naked tail, pointed snout and small ears; near drains and garbage

items.name: Indian flying fox (fruit bat)
items.visual_cues: Large bats with fox-like faces and leathery black wings, hanging upside-down in noisy colonies from big trees by day

items.name: Golden jackal
items.visual_cues: Dog-like wild animal with golden-grey coat, black-tipped bushy tail and pointed ears; seen at dusk on city edges

items.name: Rhesus macaque
items.visual_cues: Brown-grey monkey with pinkish-red bare face and rump and a short tail; troops in hill parks

items.name: Rabbit
items.visual_cues: Small furry animal with long upright ears, round body, fluffy cotton tail and twitching nose

items.name: Long-eared hedgehog
items.visual_cues: Small round animal covered in brown-and-white spines with large ears and a pointed snout; out at night

items.name: Auto rickshaw
items.visual_cues: Three-wheeled motor taxi with a rounded canvas or metal canopy, often blue-and-white or green, sometimes with chrome trim, tassels and painted art

items.name: Qingqi (Chingchi) rickshaw
items.visual_cues: Motorcycle front joined to an open passenger cart with two facing benches under a flat roof with colourful fringe; packed with riders

items.name: Truck art truck
items.visual_cues: Bedford-style truck covered in vivid painted flowers, birds, landscapes and calligraphy, mirror mosaics, dangling chains and pendants; tall carved wooden crown over the cab

items.name: Decorated minibus (W-11)
items.visual_cues: Karachi minibus covered in shiny colourful stickers, chrome, mirrors, painted motifs and lights; passengers riding on the roof

items.name: Donkey cart
items.visual_cues: Small flat wooden cart on two car tyres pulled by a donkey, loaded with goods, bricks or water drums

items.name: Camel cart
items.visual_cues: Large flat wooden platform cart on tyres pulled by a camel, heavily loaded

items.name: Horse carriage (Victoria / Tonga)
items.visual_cues: Decorated two-wheel horse-drawn carriage with a folding hood, colourful plumes, lamps and painted panels

items.name: Bicycle
items.visual_cues: Two-wheeled pedal cycle with metal frame, chain and handlebars, often parked against a wall or rail

items.name: Motorcycle
items.visual_cues: Two-wheeled motorbike; in Karachi often a red 70cc Honda-style bike, sometimes with a front basket

items.name: Fruit and vegetable cart (Thela)
items.visual_cues: Wooden hand-pushed cart on bicycle wheels piled with pyramids of colourful fruit or vegetables, sometimes with an umbrella and hanging scale

items.name: Sugarcane juice cart
items.visual_cues: Roadside cart with a big painted iron crushing machine with flywheel and rollers, stacks of sugarcane sticks and glasses of greenish juice

items.name: Roasted corn (Bhutta) cart
items.visual_cues: Small cart with a glowing charcoal bed roasting corn cobs while the vendor fans the embers

items.name: Ice cream cart
items.visual_cues: Small pushcart or tricycle with a freezer box painted with a bright brand, an umbrella and a bell

items.name: Water tanker truck
items.visual_cues: Truck carrying a large cylindrical steel water tank, often painted blue or white with phone numbers, dripping water

items.name: Wooden fishing boat
items.visual_cues: Wooden boat painted in bright colours with flags and nets piled on deck, moored in rows in the harbour

items.name: Tractor
items.visual_cues: Large red or blue farm tractor with huge rear wheels and small front wheels, often pulling a trolley

items.name: Train
items.visual_cues: Long chain of passenger coaches, often green or maroon, pulled by a diesel locomotive along the tracks

items.name: Sea waves
items.visual_cues: Rolling lines of breaking waves with white foam crests on a sandy shore, blue-grey sea stretching to the horizon

items.name: Beach shoreline
items.visual_cues: Wet glossy sand at the water's edge with thin sheets of foamy water sliding up, footprints and a flat horizon

items.name: Tide pool
items.visual_cues: Small clear pools of seawater trapped among dark rocks at low tide, with seaweed, snails or crabs inside

items.name: River
items.visual_cues: Wide flowing body of brown or blue water between banks with currents and ripples, like the Indus

items.name: Irrigation canal
items.visual_cues: Straight man-made channel of muddy water with earthen or brick banks, trees and reeds alongside

items.name: Storm drain (Nala)
items.visual_cues: Open concrete-walled city channel with dark water, floating plastic waste and reeds running through a neighbourhood

items.name: Lake
items.visual_cues: Large calm still body of water reflecting sky and shore, with trees along the edge

items.name: Pond
items.visual_cues: Small still pool of greenish water with plants around the edges, maybe lilies, ducks or algae

items.name: Puddle
items.visual_cues: Shallow rainwater pool on road or pavement, often mirror-reflecting sky, buildings or trees, with ripples

items.name: Fountain
items.visual_cues: Jets or sprays of water rising from a basin or sculpture in a park or roundabout

items.name: Waterfall
items.visual_cues: White water cascading over a rock ledge or cliff into a pool below, with misty spray

items.name: Dew drops
items.visual_cues: Tiny round glistening water beads on grass blades, leaves or spider webs in early morning

items.name: Raindrops on glass
items.visual_cues: Many water beads and streaks on a window or car surface after rain, with a blurry background

items.name: Snow
items.visual_cues: Thick fluffy white blanket covering ground, roofs and tree branches

items.name: Mangrove creek
items.visual_cues: Winding channel of tidal water lined by dense grey-green mangrove bushes with breathing roots sticking out of the mud

items.name: Marsh / wetland
items.visual_cues: Flat waterlogged land with shallow water, reeds, grasses and water birds

items.name: Cumulus clouds
items.visual_cues: Puffy white cotton-ball clouds with flat bases and rounded tops against a blue sky

items.name: Storm cloud (Cumulonimbus)
items.visual_cues: Huge towering cloud with a dark base, sometimes an anvil-shaped flat top, before thunderstorms

items.name: Cirrus clouds
items.visual_cues: Thin wispy white feather- or hair-like streaks high in a blue sky

items.name: Overcast sky (Stratus)
items.visual_cues: Flat uniform grey featureless sheet of cloud covering the whole sky

items.name: Sunset
items.visual_cues: Orange, pink and purple glow at the horizon with a low sun disc and silhouetted buildings, palms or sea

items.name: Sunrise
items.visual_cues: Soft golden-pink light as the sun appears at the horizon in early morning, long shadows

items.name: The Sun
items.visual_cues: Blinding bright white-yellow disc in the sky with lens flare; never look at it directly

items.name: Full moon
items.visual_cues: Bright round white disc with grey patches in a dark sky

items.name: Crescent moon (Hilal)
items.visual_cues: Thin curved sliver of bright moon, often low in the sky just after sunset

items.name: Half moon
items.visual_cues: Moon lit on exactly one half with a straight shadow edge and visible grey craters

items.name: Rainbow
items.visual_cues: Curved arc of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet bands across the sky after rain

items.name: Lightning
items.visual_cues: Jagged bright white-violet bolt branching across a dark storm sky; photograph from indoors or shelter

items.name: Starry night sky
items.visual_cues: Dark sky dotted with many white points of stars, maybe the Milky Way band, away from city lights

items.name: Fog / mist
items.visual_cues: White hazy air hiding the distance, objects fading into soft grey

items.name: Dust storm
items.visual_cues: Brownish-orange dusty sky with a wall of blowing dust and sand and a dim sun

items.name: Haze / smog
items.visual_cues: Dull yellow-grey murky air over the city with a washed-out sun and faded skyline

items.name: Rain
items.visual_cues: Visible streaks of falling rain, wet glossy streets, splashes in puddles and umbrellas

items.name: Airplane contrail
items.visual_cues: Long thin straight white line drawn across a blue sky behind a high airplane

items.name: Sunbeams through clouds
items.visual_cues: Visible fan-shaped shafts of light streaming down through gaps in clouds

items.name: Pebbles
items.visual_cues: Small smooth rounded stones of mixed colours (grey, white, brown) scattered or heaped

items.name: Smooth river stones
items.visual_cues: Fist-sized smooth oval water-polished grey and banded stones

items.name: Boulder
items.visual_cues: Large rounded rock bigger than a person's knee with weathered surface, maybe lichen patches

items.name: Layered sandstone rock
items.visual_cues: Tan-yellow rock with visible horizontal layers, gritty texture and eroded honeycomb holes, like Karachi hills and seaside cliffs

items.name: Beach sand
items.visual_cues: Close-up of fine golden-grey sand grains with ripples, footprints and shell bits

items.name: Sand dune
items.visual_cues: Smooth wavy rolling mounds of golden sand with wind ripples and sharp crests, like the Thar desert

items.name: Cracked dry mud
items.visual_cues: Dried earth split into polygon tiles with curled edges and deep cracks

items.name: Salt crust
items.visual_cues: White crusty salt layer on flat ground glittering in the sun, sometimes cracked into hexagons

items.name: Gravel
items.visual_cues: Heaps of small sharp-edged grey crushed stones used for construction and paths

items.name: Fallen leaves
items.visual_cues: Carpet of dry brown, yellow or red leaves on the ground or pavement

items.name: Pine cone
items.visual_cues: Woody brown egg-shaped cone made of overlapping spiral scales

items.name: Feather
items.visual_cues: Single feather lying on the ground with a central shaft and soft vanes, such as a grey pigeon or black crow feather

items.name: Tree stump
items.visual_cues: Flat cut top of a tree trunk showing concentric growth rings with bark around the edge

items.name: Fallen log
items.visual_cues: Long dead tree trunk lying on the ground with cracked bark, moss or fungi on it

items.name: Driftwood
items.visual_cues: Bleached smooth silver-grey sea-worn pieces of wood washed up on shore

items.name: Seaweed
items.visual_cues: Tangled slippery green, brown or red algae washed up on sand or rocks

items.name: Seashell
items.visual_cues: Empty hard shells on sand: spiral snail shells and fan-shaped clam shells, white, cream or patterned

items.name: Cowrie shell
items.visual_cues: Small glossy egg-shaped shell with a toothed slit underneath, spotted or plain

items.name: Bracket fungus
items.visual_cues: Hard shelf-like semicircular fungus growing out from tree trunks and logs in stacked tiers

items.name: Mushroom / toadstool
items.visual_cues: Fungus with a stalk and umbrella cap, white, brown or red, often popping up on lawns after rain; never eat wild ones

items.name: Lichen
items.visual_cues: Crusty flat patches of grey-green, orange or yellow growth on rocks, walls and bark

items.name: Moss
items.visual_cues: Soft velvety green cushion or carpet on shady walls, stones and tree bases

items.name: Termite mound
items.visual_cues: Hard earthen tower or lumpy mound of reddish-brown soil with ridges and vents

items.name: Ant hill
items.visual_cues: Small cone or crater of loose crumbly soil grains around a hole with ants going in and out

items.name: Bird nest
items.visual_cues: Cup-shaped woven nest of twigs, grass and straw in branches or on ledges

items.name: Weaver bird nest
items.visual_cues: Hanging bottle-shaped woven green-brown grass nests with a long tube entrance, dangling in clusters from palms and thorny trees

items.name: Street lamp post
items.visual_cues: Tall metal or concrete pole with an arm and lamp head over the road, glowing orange or white at night

items.name: Electric pole with tangled wires
items.visual_cues: Concrete or steel pole with a chaotic spaghetti tangle of black cables, junction boxes and hooked wires

items.name: Pole-mounted transformer
items.visual_cues: Grey metal transformer box with fins and insulators on a platform between two poles, thick cables and danger signs

items.name: Park bench
items.visual_cues: Wooden-slatted, metal or concrete seat with a backrest, in a park among trees

items.name: Manhole cover
items.visual_cues: Round or square heavy cast-iron or concrete lid set in the road, with a patterned texture and letters

items.name: Drain grate
items.visual_cues: Rectangular metal grille of parallel bars at the road edge over a drain

items.name: Graffiti / mural
items.visual_cues: Large colourful spray-painted lettering or artwork on outside walls and underpasses

items.name: Wall chalking
items.visual_cues: Hand-painted black, red or blue Urdu slogans, adverts and phone numbers on whitewashed walls

items.name: Shop signboard
items.visual_cues: Large printed or painted board above a shop with bold Urdu and English text and pictures, often crowded together

items.name: Billboard
items.visual_cues: Huge rectangular printed advertisement on a steel frame high above the road

items.name: Road sign
items.visual_cues: Metal sign on a pole: green direction board, red-rimmed circle or triangular warning symbol

items.name: Traffic light
items.visual_cues: Pole with a black or yellow box of red, amber and green round lamps at an intersection

items.name: Road barrier
items.visual_cues: Painted concrete blocks or striped metal crash barriers separating lanes

items.name: Black-and-yellow kerb
items.visual_cues: Road-edge kerbstones painted in alternating black and yellow stripes

items.name: Zebra crossing
items.visual_cues: Bold white parallel stripes painted across an asphalt road

items.name: Speed breaker
items.visual_cues: Raised hump across a road, often painted with yellow-black or white stripes

items.name: Rooftop water tank
items.visual_cues: Big cylindrical ribbed plastic tank in black, blue or white perched on rooftops, often several together

items.name: Satellite dish
items.visual_cues: Round grey or white bowl-shaped dish antenna on a mount pointing at the sky

items.name: Post box
items.visual_cues: Red metal pillar or box with a mail slot and post-office emblem

items.name: Bus stop shelter
items.visual_cues: Roofed shelter by the road with a bench, sign pole or ad panel

items.name: Garbage bin / dumpster
items.visual_cues: Large green or blue metal or plastic waste container with a lid, often overflowing

items.name: Garbage heap
items.visual_cues: Pile of mixed plastic bags and waste at the roadside, often with crows, goats or cats picking through it

items.name: Hand pump (Nalka)
items.visual_cues: Cast-iron water pump with a long lever handle and spout on a small concrete platform

items.name: Public water cooler (Sabeel)
items.visual_cues: Roadside steel water cooler or clay pots with taps and chained cups for free drinking water, often painted with an inscription

items.name: Chain-link fence
items.visual_cues: Diamond-pattern woven steel wire mesh fence on posts

items.name: Barbed wire
items.visual_cues: Twisted wire strands with sharp spiky barbs, often coiled on top of walls

items.name: Brick wall
items.visual_cues: Wall of red or yellow rectangular bricks in rows with mortar lines, sometimes crumbling

items.name: Rolling shop shutter
items.visual_cues: Corrugated metal roll-down shutter on a closed shop, grey or painted with adverts

items.name: Iron gate
items.visual_cues: Painted wrought-iron or sheet-metal house gate with bars and decorative patterns

items.name: Pigeon loft (Kabootar khana)
items.visual_cues: Wire-mesh or wooden coop on a rooftop with pigeons, flags and perch poles

items.name: Paper kite (Patang)
items.visual_cues: Diamond-shaped colourful tissue-paper kite with a bamboo spine, flying on a string or stuck on electric wires

items.name: Flag
items.visual_cues: Fabric flag waving on a pole, such as the green-and-white Pakistan flag with crescent and star

items.name: Clothes drying line
items.visual_cues: Washed clothes hung with pegs on rope or wire, flapping on rooftops and balconies

items.name: Solar panel
items.visual_cues: Dark blue or black rectangular grid-lined glass panels tilted toward the sun on roofs or poles

items.name: Air conditioner outdoor unit
items.visual_cues: Box-shaped white or grey unit with a round fan grille bolted to outside walls, often many stacked on a building face

items.name: Mobile phone tower
items.visual_cues: Tall steel lattice tower or pole with rectangular panel antennas and small dishes

items.name: Electricity pylon
items.visual_cues: Huge steel lattice tower carrying high-voltage cables with hanging insulator strings across the countryside

items.name: Wind turbine
items.visual_cues: Tall white tower with three long slim rotating blades, as in the Jhimpir wind farms

items.name: Playground swing
items.visual_cues: Metal frame with seats hanging from chains

items.name: Road milestone
items.visual_cues: Small white-painted concrete marker with a yellow or red rounded top showing a city name and kilometres

items.name: Roadside tea stall (Dhaba)
items.visual_cues: Open-air stall with big aluminium kettles on a burner, plastic chairs, woven charpai cots and steaming cups of chai

items.name: Road bridge
items.visual_cues: Concrete or steel bridge spanning a river, canal or road, with railings and pillars

items.name: Pedestrian overhead bridge
items.visual_cues: Narrow steel or concrete walkway bridge over a busy road with stairs at both ends, often covered in ad banners

items.name: Flyover / overpass
items.visual_cues: Elevated concrete road on large pillars over an intersection

items.name: Railway track
items.visual_cues: Two steel rails on wooden or concrete sleepers over grey gravel, stretching into the distance

items.name: Mosque dome
items.visual_cues: Large rounded onion or half-sphere dome, often white, green or tiled, with a crescent finial on top

items.name: Minaret
items.visual_cues: Tall slender tower beside a mosque with balconies and a pointed cap, often with loudspeakers

items.name: Sufi shrine (Mazar)
items.visual_cues: Tomb building with a green or white dome, green flags, strings of lights and blue-and-white tile work

items.name: Hindu temple
items.visual_cues: Temple with a tall tapering carved spire (shikhara), saffron flags and painted figures

items.name: Church spire
items.visual_cues: Pointed steeple tower topped with a cross, with gothic arched windows

items.name: Clock tower
items.visual_cues: Tall tower with large clock faces near the top on each side

items.name: Colonial stone building
items.visual_cues: Yellow sandstone British-era facade with arches, columns, carved balconies and wooden shutters, as in old Karachi

items.name: Old haveli with jharokhas
items.visual_cues: Old townhouse with carved wooden overhanging balconies, lattice screens and arched doorways

items.name: Ruins
items.visual_cues: Crumbling broken walls, arches and foundations of ancient brick or stone buildings

items.name: Fort wall
items.visual_cues: Massive notched stone or brick defensive walls with round bastions and battlements, like Ranikot

items.name: Old city gate
items.visual_cues: Large ornamental arched gateway of brick or stone with towers on either side

items.name: Chaukhandi tombs
items.visual_cues: Stacked rectangular honey-yellow sandstone graves carved with intricate geometric and rosette patterns, near Karachi

items.name: Lighthouse
items.visual_cues: Tall round tower with a glass lantern room on top, often striped, on a rocky point such as Manora

items.name: Pier / jetty
items.visual_cues: Wooden or concrete walkway reaching out over water on pillars, with boats tied alongside

items.name: Port cranes and containers
items.visual_cues: Giant red, blue or yellow gantry cranes beside stacks of colourful shipping containers at the port

items.name: Overhead water tower
items.visual_cues: Elevated concrete tank shaped like a mushroom or cup on tall columns

items.name: Windcatcher (Badgir)
items.visual_cues: Slanted box-shaped rooftop vents all facing the sea breeze, in rows on old Hyderabad rooftops

items.name: Mud house
items.visual_cues: Single-storey house with smooth brown mud-plastered walls, flat roof and a wooden door, sometimes with painted motifs

items.name: Thatched round hut (Chaunra)
items.visual_cues: Round mud-walled hut with a conical thatched straw roof, as in the Thar desert

items.name: Brick kiln chimney
items.visual_cues: Tall tapering brick chimney smoking above rows of stacked bricks in a field

items.name: Mazar-e-Quaid
items.visual_cues: Massive white marble cube-shaped mausoleum with a single dome and tall pointed arches on a raised platform, surrounded by gardens and fountains (Karachi)

items.name: Frere Hall
items.visual_cues: Victorian Gothic hall of yellowish-grey sandstone with pointed arches and a square tower, set in green lawns (Karachi)

items.name: Teen Talwar (Three Swords)
items.visual_cues: Monument of three tall white marble swords pointing upward on a roundabout in Clifton, Karachi

items.name: Empress Market
items.visual_cues: Colonial stone market building with a tall central clock tower and gothic arches, crowded bazaar around it (Karachi)

items.name: Mango
items.visual_cues: Oval kidney-shaped fruit, green to golden-yellow with red blush and smooth skin, hanging on long stalks or piled in crates

items.name: Banana bunch
items.visual_cues: Curved elongated yellow or green fingers in clustered hands

items.name: Coconut
items.visual_cues: Large green or brown hairy oval nut, often cut open with a straw at beach carts

items.name: Dates
items.visual_cues: Hanging clusters of small oblong glossy yellow, orange-red or brown fruits on a palm, or piled sticky dark brown

items.name: Guava
items.visual_cues: Round to pear-shaped green to yellow fruit with bumpy skin; pink or white flesh with small seeds when cut

items.name: Papaya
items.visual_cues: Large elongated pear-shaped green to orange fruit; orange flesh with black seeds when cut

items.name: Pomegranate (Anar)
items.visual_cues: Round leathery red fruit with a crown-shaped tip, full of ruby-red juicy seeds

items.name: Lemon / lime
items.visual_cues: Small round or oval green-yellow citrus with glossy dimpled skin

items.name: Kinnow orange
items.visual_cues: Bright orange round loose-skinned mandarin with dimpled peel, piled on winter carts

items.name: Jamun
items.visual_cues: Small olive-shaped glossy deep-purple to black berries that stain purple, sold with salt

items.name: Ber
items.visual_cues: Small round or oval cherry-sized glossy fruits, green-yellow turning reddish-brown

items.name: Falsa
items.visual_cues: Tiny pea-sized round dark purple to reddish berries sold in heaps in summer

items.name: Tamarind pods
items.visual_cues: Curved brown lumpy bean-like pods with brittle shell and sticky brown pulp

items.name: Mulberries (Shahtoot)
items.visual_cues: Elongated bumpy berries like tiny blackberries, white, red or black

items.name: Chikoo (Sapodilla)
items.visual_cues: Small oval fruit with rough sandy-brown potato-like skin; sweet brown flesh

items.name: Custard apple (Sharifa)
items.visual_cues: Round green fruit with knobby scale-like segments; creamy white flesh with black seeds

items.name: Watermelon
items.visual_cues: Huge oval or round fruit with dark-green striped rind; red juicy flesh with black seeds when cut

items.name: Melon (Kharbooza)
items.visual_cues: Medium round melon with a netted beige or ribbed green rind; orange flesh

items.name: Lychee
items.visual_cues: Bunches of small round fruits with bumpy pink-red leathery skin and white see-through flesh

items.name: Apple
items.visual_cues: Round glossy red, green or yellow fruit with a stem dimple

items.name: Grapes
items.visual_cues: Clusters of small round green or purple berries on stems

items.name: Drumstick pods
items.visual_cues: Long thin green ribbed stick-like pods 30-50 cm long, hanging or tied in bundles

items.name: Okra (Bhindi)
items.visual_cues: Slim green ridged pointed pods with fuzzy skin, piled on vegetable carts

items.name: Eggplant (Baingan)
items.visual_cues: Glossy deep-purple oval or long fruit with a green spiky cap

items.name: Tomato
items.visual_cues: Round glossy red fruit with a green star-shaped stem cap

items.name: Onion
items.visual_cues: Round bulbs with papery red-pink or golden skin, piled in heaps

items.name: Potato
items.visual_cues: Lumpy oval tubers with thin brown skin and dirt, heaped

items.name: Cauliflower
items.visual_cues: Dense white bumpy head wrapped in green leaves

items.name: Cabbage
items.visual_cues: Tight round head of overlapping smooth pale-green leaves

items.name: Red carrot (Sindhi gajar)
items.visual_cues: Long tapering deep red-crimson carrots with green tops, piled in winter

items.name: Bitter gourd (Karela)
items.visual_cues: Spindle-shaped green fruit covered in warty ridges and bumps

items.name: Bottle gourd (Lauki)
items.visual_cues: Long smooth pale-green bottle- or club-shaped gourd

items.name: Pumpkin
items.visual_cues: Big round ribbed orange or green-mottled squash

items.name: Green chili
items.visual_cues: Heaps of slender glossy green pointed peppers, sometimes red

items.name: Corn on the cob
items.visual_cues: Cylindrical cob of yellow kernel rows in green husks with silky tassels; roasted on carts
